questions.question: You may tow another vehicle on the public road if...

options.text: The length of the tow-rope between the two vehicles is less than 3.5 metres
The length of the tow-rope between the two vehicles is 3.5 metres
The length of the tow-rope between the two vehicles is 2.5 metres

options.text: Pedal cycle
Sport utility vehicle
A bakkie

options.text: 120 kilometres per hour
100 kilometres per hour
60 kilometres per hour

options.text: 3 days in an urban area
7 days in the same place on a public road within an urban area
5 days in an urban area

options.text: Exceed the speed limit when overtaking
